description: Average the points won per death country, leaving out players with no recorded death country. Compare each country's average with the plain average of the remaining countries' averages.

b.request: For players with award votes and recorded death countries, group by death_country, calculate the average points_won per country (excluding NULL values), compute the mean of these country-level averages, and display each death_country with its average points_won and its deviation from the overall mean of the country averages.
b.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player p INNER JOIN player_award_vote pav ON p.player_id = pav.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as mean_of_averages FROM country_averages) SELECT ca.death_country, ca.avg_points_won, ca.avg_points_won - om.mean_of_averages as deviation FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY ca.death_country
b.raw: For players with award votes and recorded death countries, group by death_country, calculate the average points_won per country (excluding NULL values), compute the mean of these country-level averages, and display each death_country with its average points_won and its deviation from the overall mean of the country averages.

a.request: For award vote records matched to their players by `player_id` (dropping votes with no matching player), group by the player's death country (`death_country`), leaving out players with a blank death country. For each group, show the death country, the average `points_won` (ignoring missing values), and how far that average is from the simple average of the group averages across the remaining groups. Don't round.
a.sql:
WITH player_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    pav.player_id,
    pav.points_won,
    p.death_country
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != ''
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(points_won) as avg_points_won
  FROM player_votes
  WHERE points_won IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT 
  ga.death_country,
  ga.avg_points_won,
  ga.avg_points_won - (
    SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) 
    FROM group_averages ga2 
    WHERE ga2.death_country != ga.death_country
  ) as difference_from_other_groups_average
FROM group_averages ga
ORDER BY ga.death_country

c.request: For players who received award votes (matched to `player` by `player_id`), what is the average `points_won` for each death country (ignoring missing points)? Show each death country, its average, and how far it is from the simple average of those per-country averages, without rounding. Average the points won per death country, leaving out players with no recorded death country. Compare each country's average with the plain average of the remaining countries' averages.
c.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as avg_of_avgs FROM country_averages) SELECT ca.death_country, ca.avg_points_won, ca.avg_points_won - oa.avg_of_avgs as distance_from_overall_avg FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ca.death_country

d.request: For players with award votes and non-null death countries, calculate the mean points_won per death country and display each death country's average alongside its difference from the mean of all per-country averages.
d.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as mean_of_averages FROM country_averages) SELECT ca.death_country, ca.avg_points_won, ca.avg_points_won - om.mean_of_averages as difference_from_mean FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY ca.death_country;
